# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied on the `main` branch. Tagged releases will be listed here when the project publishes them.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/markheydon/letoryn-m365/security/advisories/new) for this repository when available, or contact the maintainer through a private channel you already use for Letoryn development.

Include:

- A description of the issue and likely impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept
- Affected components (Web, API, AppHost, infrastructure) if known

We will acknowledge reports as soon as practicable and coordinate disclosure after a fix is ready.
